title: Coupling graph edge v0
description: One relation in the system coupling graph. Every edge says where it came from: 'static' (read from source code), 'runtime' (seen in telemetry), 'inferred' (an agent's proposed claim) or 'verified' (a supported claim). Analyses must never present an inferred edge as an observed fact.

rel.description: Same vocabulary as claim relations, plus 'contains' (file contains symbol) and 'imports'.

resolution.description: How a static edge was resolved. exact: unambiguous (same file, explicit import, literal string). name_match: the only definition with that name in the project. ambiguous: one of 2-3 same-named definitions, may be wrong; analyses do not follow it. heuristic: pattern-based (e.g. attribute writes, SQL in strings).

claim.description: For inferred / verified edges: the claim they come from.
